ci_support_win_64_.yaml:
c_compiler:
- vs2022
channel_sources:
- conda-forge
channel_targets:
- conda-forge main
target_platform:
- win-64

about.description:
This package installs clang compiler, lld linker, tools like llvm-ranlib, llvm-ar,
bash, autoconf to compiler autotools on windows. Resulting packages will be MSVC compatible.
To use this package, in meta.yaml

    build:
      skip: True  # [win and vc<14]
    requirements:
      build:
        # cl compiler on win is required only for setting up env variables for
        # activating the build environment
        - {{ compiler('c') }}
        - autotools_clang_conda  # [win]
        # Needed only if OpenMP is used. Not compatible with MSVC's OpenMP implementation
        - llvm-openmp   # [win]

In bld.bat

    call %BUILD_PREFIX%\Library\bin\run_autotools_clang_conda_build.bat
    if %ERRORLEVEL% neq 0 exit 1

In build.sh

    ./configure --prefix=$PREFIX
    [[ "$target_platform" == win-* ]] && patch_libtool
    make -j${CPU_COUNT}
    make install

In case the build script has a different name (for example in multi-output recipes),
you can pass the name of the build script in the recipe folder to the bat-script:

In build_subpackage.bat

    call %BUILD_PREFIX%\Library\bin\run_autotools_clang_conda_build.bat build_subpackage.sh
    if %ERRORLEVEL% neq 0 exit 1
about.summary: Scripts to compile autotools projects on windows using clang and llvm tools

name: autotools_clang_conda
raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  # Keep documentation examples separate from recipe comment selectors.
  doc_comment: "#"

package:
  name: autotools_clang_conda
  version: 0.0.14

build:
  number: 2
  skip: not win

requirements:
  run:
    - clang
    - clangxx
    - llvm-tools
    - lld
    - m2-automake-wrapper
    - m2-libtool
    - m2-autoconf
    - m2-make
    - m2-findutils
    - m2-m4
    - m2-bash
    - m2-sed
    - m2-base
    - m2-diffutils
    - m2-tar
    - m2-unzip
    - m2-zip
    - cmake

tests:
  - script:
      - if not exist %LIBRARY_BIN%\run_autotools_clang_conda_build.bat exit 1
  - files:
      recipe:
        - tests/autotools-smoke/
    requirements:
      run:
        - ${{ compiler('c') }}
    script:
      - call tests\autotools-smoke\run-smoke.bat

about:
  license: BSD-3-Clause
  license_file: LICENSE
  summary: Scripts to compile autotools projects on windows using clang and llvm tools
  description: |
    This package installs clang compiler, lld linker, tools like llvm-ranlib, llvm-ar,
    bash, autoconf to compiler autotools on windows. Resulting packages will be MSVC compatible.
    To use this package, in meta.yaml

        build:
          skip: True  ${{ doc_comment }} [win and vc<14]
        requirements:
          build:
            # cl compiler on win is required only for setting up env variables for
            # activating the build environment
            - {{ compiler('c') }}
            - autotools_clang_conda  ${{ doc_comment }} [win]
            # Needed only if OpenMP is used. Not compatible with MSVC's OpenMP implementation
            - llvm-openmp   ${{ doc_comment }} [win]

    In bld.bat

        call %BUILD_PREFIX%\Library\bin\run_autotools_clang_conda_build.bat
        if %ERRORLEVEL% neq 0 exit 1

    In build.sh

        ./configure --prefix=$PREFIX
        [[ "$target_platform" == win-* ]] && patch_libtool
        make -j${CPU_COUNT}
        make install

    In case the build script has a different name (for example in multi-output recipes),
    you can pass the name of the build script in the recipe folder to the bat-script:

    In build_subpackage.bat

        call %BUILD_PREFIX%\Library\bin\run_autotools_clang_conda_build.bat build_subpackage.sh
        if %ERRORLEVEL% neq 0 exit 1
  homepage: http://github.com/conda-forge/autotools_clang_conda-feedstock

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - isuruf
